readme.label: Purpose
readme.value: Manage equipment specifications, locations, stable IDs, control mapping and electrical-line specifications against one shared layout.

readme.label: Baseline
readme.value: Lighting. Reading, sanctuary, circulation, paths, facade and festival exterior lighting. Model snapshot: 2026-10-07T12:10:03.268Z.

readme.label: Coordinates
readme.value: Metres: X toward sanctuary from axis 1; Y up from nave ±0.000; negative Z toward B, positive toward H.

readme.label: Amber columns
readme.value: Editable engineering inputs. Approved products/specifications, control IDs, notes and cable allowances survive refresh by ID. Blank means pending.

readme.label: Model columns
readme.value: Imported positions, IDs, planning specs and route vertices refresh from paired layout/systems exports. Use Proposed X/Y/Z for position revisions.

readme.label: Position changes
readme.value: Enter all three Proposed coordinates; export a draft layout, import it in the viewer, check supports/aim/clearances, then export matching layout and systems JSON. Enclosures require a coordinated model-source change.

readme.label: Line lengths
readme.value: Route length sums the ordered 3D segments. Full home-run length adds its upstream path once. Do not add shared bundles again; no procurement total is implied.

readme.label: Specifications
readme.value: Catalogue values and procedural dimensions are planning proxies. Final cable type, core count, cross-section, containment and approvals remain blank until designed.

readme.label: Known limits
readme.value: Physical switching channels and cable specifications are pending. Current feedback, speech clarity and other design shortfalls remain open.

readme.value: Reading, sanctuary, circulation, paths, facade and festival exterior lighting. Shared board sources are cross-references to the distribution-controls register; they are not duplicated here. Architectural fabric stays in the drawing specifications.

readme.value: Design development; not issued for purchasing, installation or construction.
